svg.title: The Five-Person Core and Seven-Person Expansion
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-five-to-seven-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: The Five-Person Core and Seven-Person Expansion; subtitle: Two full-time seats plus three contractors; add one of each at scale.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time; C means contractor. Numeric values show Base seat occupancy: five occupied seats and two expansion seats at zero. Conservative and Base use 2 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 3 FT + 4 C. Contractor seats represent people, not full-time equivalents. Role design is illustrative; contractor status depends on the actual working relationship.; caption: The account director owns client acceptance; the CRM specialist maintains evidence; the operator lead resolves pricing, capacity, and customer-concentration decisions.; stages: label: Operator lead; value: Core FT seat: own sales, pricing, capacity, and cash.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the agency sales pipeline, approve commercial terms, review client concentration monthly, and compare collections with payroll and contractor commitments.; label: Account director; value: Core FT seat: own client outcomes and acceptance quality.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Translate client strategy into account plans, run delivery reviews, secure opportunity acceptance, and resolve scope issues before they become attribution disputes.; label: Account research specialist; value: Core C seat: own target research and signal qualification.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Produce sourced account briefs, maintain identity matching, check suppression records, and flag weak buying signals before campaign production consumes delivery capacity.; label: Campaign production specialist; value: Core C seat: own messaging assets and outreach preparation.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Develop account-relevant messaging, prepare channel-specific campaign assets, inspect suppression settings, and route substantive replies into the client-account record.; label: CRM and attribution specialist; value: Core C seat: own scheduling, acceptance evidence, and reconciliation.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Configure Salesforce or HubSpot workflows, connect Calendly routing, preserve source timestamps, deduplicate events, and reconcile accepted opportunities with invoice lines.; label: Client success manager; value: Expansion FT seat: activate for the seven-person Scaled pod.; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add one full-time person to absorb onboarding, reporting, and renewal coordination when measured account workload exceeds the core account director's sustainable capacity.; label: Research and production support; value: Expansion C seat: activate for the seven-person Scaled pod.; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add one contracted specialist for the demonstrated research or production bottleneck. Preserve qualification standards rather than increasing volume through weaker acceptance criteria.
